sources.shortCitation: Novaphon Electro Record B Nr. 4051, “Du bist verrückt, mein Schatz, du denkst an Liebe”
sources.fullCitation: Tanzorchester J. Geiger, refrain sung by Hans Rotter. “Du bist verrückt, mein Schatz, du denkst an Liebe.” Lied und foxtrot; label credits music and text to Fritz Rotter and Dr. B. Kaper. Novaphon Electro Record B 4051, made in Austria, n.d. Flexible disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: Du bist verrückt, mein Schatz, du denkst an Liebe — Novaphon Electro Record B Nr. 4051
sources.creator: Tanzorchester J. Geiger, Refraingesang: Hans Rotter
sources.date: n.d. [issued in Austria about 1931 according to the uploader]
sources.researchNote: The matrix number is only partly legible on the filmed label. The uploader expands the ensemble name to Tanzorchester Isy Geiger and dates the issue to about 1931; those details are not printed in full on the label.
